verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud agent product, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting or control that lets a user disable telemetry or usage tracking. The Computer Analytics API is an admin reporting feature that exposes per-member usage, so it is adjacent and does not show an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
